Natu

Psychic Flying

Johto · Generation 2

Natu is a Psychic/Flying-type Tiny Bird Pokémon first found in Johto (Generation 2). It stands 0.2 m tall and weighs 2 kg. It evolves into Xatu. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (70), with a base stat total of 320.
